content.text:
[Image #1] bug: in quick amount editing mode, the num keypad covers up the quick amount buttons. it is very easily for the user to make a mistake when they tap into the quick amount buttons -- they would accidently tap the num keypad buttons.

suggestions:

1. hide the num keypad in quick amount editing mode.
2. fix the layout of the num keypad, so that when the actually soft keyboard pops up, the num keypad won't shift and cover up the quick amount buttons.
